summary: Re-tested Feature 2 (Purchasing Plan 'Split Qty' supplier toggle) which was blocked in iteration_60 by the OMS ReadTimeout crash bug. That bug is now confirmed FIXED: ran two full end-to-end plan generations for target month 2026-09 via the UI, both completed successfully in ~240s (well within the expected 2-5 min window, no timeouts/crashes), rendering all 879 components. Verified SPC5WM's Split Qty toggle exactly: expands to show supplier '165 DEGREE' at 60% quota with Sep 2026 Order Qty = 2,57,394.6 (== 428991.0 * 0.60, exact match to spec), and collapses cleanly on second click (sub-row disappears). Verified SCR415WM's zero-quantity edge case: toggle expands showing all 3 suppliers (SUPER FASTENERS 55%, S.FASTNERS 30%, SUAKSI HARDWARES 15%) each with Order Qty rendering as clean '0' (not blank/NaN/undefined).
